primary.notes_base: After the Trois Lacs hike, the return journey to Paris is a priority. Allow adequate time for the taxi/bus to the train station (Remiremont or Epinal, approximately 45-60 min from Gerardmer/Orbey). Pack a substantial trail snack or buy a hot meal at the station before boarding. Journey time Paris is approximately 4h with TER + TGV connection. Buying provisions in Gerardmer before leaving (local Munster, charcuterie, bread) makes for an authentic picnic on the train.
primary.notes_local: Apres la randonnee des Trois Lacs, prevoir suffisamment de temps pour le transport vers la gare (Remiremont ou Epinal, environ 45-60 min). Acheter un repas chaud a la gare ou preparer des provisions a Gerardmer. Trajet retour vers Paris environ 4h.
